userStories.title: Divergence tracker module (haircut expectation, halt logic)
userStories.description: As an operator, I want daily realized-vs-backtest divergence computed with an honest (haircut) expectation, alerting on drift and writing the breaker halt file on severe breach. [PRD US-009 part 1]
acceptanceCriteria: New execution/divergence.py: loads Alpaca portfolio history since promoted_at, loads promoted workspace's ret.pkl daily-return distribution; sigma from the full test window; expectation mu_adj = 0.5 * backtest mean (haircut factor configurable under a divergence: config section)
Computes trailing 20-trading-day realized return vs expected 20*mu_adj and z = (realized - 20*mu_adj) / (sigma * sqrt(20))

z < -2 posts a Slack warning with realized vs expected numbers and drawdown since promotion; z < -3 OR drawdown since promotion > backtest MDD * 1.25 writes the existing breaker halt file (same file execution/breaker.py checks) and posts a rotating_light Slack notice naming the trigger and the manual clear procedure
Fewer than 20 trading days since promotion: posts nothing, exits 0 (warmup)
Module never trades and never modifies state other than the halt file; failures post a Slack error notice (same pattern as rebalance/pred-refresh)
Tests cover: z-score math with haircut, alert threshold, halt threshold via z, halt threshold via drawdown, warmup, halt-file write
Typecheck passes (make check: ruff + pyright + pytest)
